display.title: Episode 460: Little Zalmy and the Spooky House, Chapter 2
display.summary_short: Uncle Yossi celebrates ten years of Tzivos Hashem on the Air, and the spooky house mystery is solved: young Schneur Zalman has been teaching poor children Torah there.
display.summary_long: Episode 460 marks the start of the program's eleventh year. Uncle Yossi looks back on ten years of marches, stories, Mitzvah Time and contests, and notes that some early listeners are now grown up and still tuning in. After the Hakochainik march, a yeshiva student recites the Shema in Studio 604 and everyone gives tzedakah. Story time concludes 'Little Zalmy and the Spooky House'. Zelig and Shimmy hide inside the house at night, sure that robbers are coming, but the footsteps belong to a group of children led by their classmate Schneur Zalman. He brings baskets of cookies and treats, teaches the children to make brachos, and gently encourages Meir, a poor boy who cannot yet read, that Hashem treasures every letter he learns and that helping his parents is a mitzvah too. Inspired, Zelig and Shimmy decide to gather children and teach them as well. Uncle Yossi reveals that little Schneur Zalman grew up to be the Alter Rebbe. The show ends with candle-lighting times and Dial-a-Jewish-Story.
display.lesson: Ahavas Yisroel means sharing what you have, both your treats and your Torah, with children who have less; Hashem treasures every word of Torah a child learns.
